title: Chicken and sweetcorn soup
summary: Chicken and sweetcorn soup is a mexican dinner built around skinless chicken breast fillets and canned sweetcorn, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Chicken and sweetcorn soup. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add skinless chicken breast fillets and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and canned sweetcorn.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until onions is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Chicken and sweetcorn soup before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Chicken and sweetcorn soup.
